newsitem.title: USA: Mikohn wins patent suit over Flip It game.
newsitem.headline: Mikohn wins patent suit over Flip It game.

text.p: Mikohn Gaming Corp on Wednesday said it has won a patent infringement suit against Planet Earth Entertainment over its Flip It slot machine game.

The ruling by U.S. District Judge Howard McKibben orders Planet Earth to pay Mikohn more than $48,000 in damages plus attorneys fees and other costs. From September 1992 to August 1993, Planet Earth sold a machine called Flip 'n Win that was similar to Flip It, according to Mikohn.
Planet Earth also was permanently enjoined from making, using or selling any Flip 'n Win, Dinoscore, Fling Shot or other machines having mechanisms infringing Mikohn's patent.
